origin: Real browser capture of a local MonliPay build connected to Monad testnet; automated dedicated demo wallet; confirmation waits shortened.

scenes.caption: Send tokens with a link. Real Monad testnet demo. Wallet confirmations are automated.
Choose a token. Set the amount. Fund the link. 12.34 DEMOUSD: a six-decimal test token with no monetary value.
Open the link and claim the payment. The transaction receipt confirms the token transfer.
Save the wallets you send to. Contacts are private. Unlock them with a wallet signature.
Sharing with a group? Choose Lucky Link. Set the pool, recipient slots, and eligible wallets.
One random share per eligible wallet. Pyth Entropy settles the draw. Fees and gas are paid in MON.
Reveal the amount. Collect your share. This is a real testnet withdrawal. Confirmation waits are shortened.
Every link, in one place. Track Payment and Lucky Links. Refund available funds after expiry.
